title: How Banks can Adopt AI Without Losing Customer Trust
summary:
Avaya's Cameron Thomson on why banks should automate where confidence is high, keephumans where the stakes rise, and modernise piece by piece.
The post How Banks can Adopt AI Without Losing Customer Trust appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Banks looking to adopt artificial intelligence must balance automation with maintaining customer trust. According to industry insights from Avaya's Cameron Thomson, financial institutions should implement automation primarily in areas with high confidence levels. Furthermore, banks need to keep human representatives involved when the stakes are high, while modernising their technological infrastructure incrementally rather than all at once.
